# Gcore Public DNS

> View Gcore Public DNS resolver addresses and access configuration guides for plain DNS, DoH, and DoT.

- [Public DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/public-dns.md): View Gcore Public DNS resolver addresses and access configuration guides for plain DNS, DoH, and DoT.
- [Configure a DNS resolver](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/configure-plain-dns.md): Configure Gcore Public DNS plain resolver addresses on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and routers.
- [Configure DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/configure-doh-and-dot.md): Configure Gcore Public DNS encrypted resolvers using DNS over HTTPS or DNS over TLS on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and in browsers.
- [Troubleshoot Gcore Public DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/troubleshoot-public-dns.md): Troubleshoot common issues with Gcore Public DNS - DNS changes not applying, DoH and DoT connection failures, resolver conflicts, and DNSSEC behavior.
